name: review-agent-pi
description: pi 内核线的 Review CLI 产品仓：一次检视产出英文 findings + 中文按行分组建议（ADR-0024）

scripts.build:pi: pnpm --filter @review-agent-pi/pi-telemetry run build && pnpm --filter @review-agent-pi/chord run build && pnpm --filter @review-agent-pi/pi-ai run build && pnpm --filter @review-agent-pi/pi-agent-core run build
scripts.build:presentation: pnpm --filter review-pi build && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.presentation.json && node scripts/copy-presentation.mjs
scripts.build:dist: pnpm build:pi && pnpm --filter review-llm build && pnpm build:presentation
